create_event_storage: create an EventStorage context to track training metrics and scalars during model training iterations
write_json_metrics: write training scalars and loss metrics to a JSON file using JSONWriter with median smoothing
write_tensorboard_logs: write training scalars images and histograms to TensorBoard using TensorboardXWriter for visualization
print_common_metrics: print common training metrics like iteration time ETA losses and learning rate to the terminal
get_event_storage: get the current EventStorage instance from the active context stack to record or query metrics
